purpose: Rhythm-game tap chart; onset-based subdivision candidates, not melodic transcription
timingReference: Seconds from beginning of original MP3; compare against audio.currentTime
syncMethod: Global adaptive beat tracking, robust linear tempo baseline, four-bar median drift assessment and smoothly interpolated phase corrections; subdivisions anchored to corrected beats
phaseNote: First detected beat treated as beat 1; 2nd-beat accent is inferred rather than manually verified against music meter

silenceFilter.approach: Omit note candidates during end fade or with very low local RMS; do not emit notes without sound-level and onset confidence
